title: Complaint Handling Policy
summary: Guidelines for submitting feedback and the process by which Ruby Travel receives, reviews, responds to, and resolves complaints.

sections.heading: 1. Contact Channels
paragraphs: Customers can submit feedback, support requests, or complaints via hotline {{phone}}, email at {{email}}, or the online support channels published on the website.

sections.heading: 2. Required Information
items: The sender's full name and contact information.
Order code/ticket code, booking time, and relevant product (if applicable).
A clear description of the issue, requested resolution, and when it occurred.
Relevant documents, such as booking confirmations, payment receipts, or screenshots of errors. Please conceal any unnecessary sensitive information.

sections.heading: 3. Complaint Resolution Process
items: Step 1 – Receipt: Ruby Travel records the complaint details and the customer's contact information.
Step 2 – Verification: Ruby Travel checks the order, payment status, and ticket information, and contacts the supplier or payment provider when necessary.
Step 3 – Response: Ruby Travel informs the customer of the verification results, proposed resolution, or any additional information required.
Step 4 – Completion: Ruby Travel implements the agreed resolution and notifies the customer of the outcome.

sections.heading: 4. Processing Time
paragraphs: Ruby Travel aims to acknowledge receipt of requests between 6:00 AM and 4:00 PM and respond with the outcome within 24 hours after receiving all required information. If verification with a third party or supplier is necessary, processing may take longer. Ruby Travel will inform the customer of the reason and expected timeline.

sections.heading: 5. Resolution Principles
paragraphs: Complaints are reviewed based on order information, supporting documents, ticket conditions at the time of purchase, and the supplier's regulations. Ruby Travel prioritizes good-faith, transparent resolution while protecting customers' legitimate rights and interests.
If customers disagree with the resolution, they may contact Ruby Travel again or submit a request to the competent state authorities in accordance with applicable laws.

support.title: Need further assistance?
support.description: Contact Ruby Travel for assistance and answers to your questions.
